motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and compact state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(24% 0.008 145); color: oklch(99% 0.004 90); font: 600 14px/1.3 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: oklch(30% 0.008 145); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(52% 0.120 35 / .35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action with equal usability and lower emphasis.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(87% 0.010 90); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(99% 0.004 90); color: oklch(24% 0.008 145); font: 600 14px/1.3 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: oklch(94% 0.008 90); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(52% 0.120 35 / .35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Visible-label field for ordinary and secret settings.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: oklch(24% 0.008 145); font: 600 14px/1.3 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(87% 0.010 90); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(99% 0.004 90); color: oklch(24% 0.008 145); font: 400 16px/1.55 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(52% 0.120 35); outline: 3px solid oklch(52% 0.120 35 / .22); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Top-level route with explicit label and restrained selection.
components.html: Brief
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: oklch(24% 0.008 145); font: 600 14px/1.3 Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(94% 0.008 90); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page'] { background: oklch(94% 0.008 90); color: oklch(46% 0.110 35); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(52% 0.120 35 / .35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Provider Row
components.description: Scannable inline provider status and action.
components.css: .ds-provider-row { display: flex; min-height: 64px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(87% 0.010 90); color: oklch(24% 0.008 145); font-family: Aptos, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-provider-row div { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-provider-row strong { font-size: 15px; } .ds-provider-row span { color: oklch(47% 0.010 145); font-size: 14px; } .ds-provider-row button { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(87% 0.010 90); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(99% 0.004 90); color: oklch(24% 0.008 145); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-provider-row button:hover { background: oklch(94% 0.008 90); } .ds-provider-row button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(52% 0.120 35 / .35); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Creative Curator should feel like a well-arranged work surface: quiet until needed, precise under pressure, and organized around the decision in front of the user. Familiar product patterns, concise language, and visible system state create trust. This target system replaces publication-like treatment with mineral neutrals, restrained rust, compact sans-serif type, and flat product structure.
keyCharacteristics: One sans-serif family and compact, fixed type hierarchy
Mineral neutrals with rust reserved for focus and meaningful state
Borders and tonal shifts before shadows
Clear labels, inline feedback, and persistent user context

rules.name: The Ten Percent Rule
rules.body: Rust occupies no more than ten percent of a normal workspace view. It communicates focus, selection, or recovery, never atmosphere.

rules.name: The State Needs Words Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, and error colors always appear with text or an icon label. Color never carries meaning alone.

rules.name: The Product Type Rule
rules.body: No serif type, fluid display scaling, all-caps micro-label systems, or headings larger than needed to orient the task.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Persistent content does not float. If a border or tonal layer can explain structure, no shadow is added.

dos: Do use the 4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 24px, 32px, and 48px spacing scale.
Do keep primary actions at least 44px high and provide visible keyboard focus.
Do validate fields on blur, place errors beside the field, and include a recovery action.
Do preserve drafts, sessions, and user settings across expected navigation and login cycles.
Do use one consistent SVG icon family and pair unfamiliar icons with labels.
Do test 375px, 768px, 1024px, and 1440px layouts plus reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't use editorial-magazine styling, including oversized serif headlines, ornamental layouts, or content staged like a publication.
Don't use generic AI-product styling, including gradient text, glowing surfaces, glass-heavy cards, decorative automation diagrams, or vague assistant copy.
Don't use glossy SaaS presentation patterns that make configuration and creative work feel like a marketing page.
Don't invent novel controls or decorative motion for standard workflows.
Don't use colored side-stripe alerts, nested cards, identical promotional card grids, or modals as the first solution.
Don't animate layout properties, remove focus outlines, rely on hover alone, or communicate status with color alone.
